tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across public Petify products, services and editorial resources. Returns canonical links and source text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one public record by ID returned by search.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Mexican product offers with seller, price, recorded availability and catalog photos when available. Pass the original search terms. When inline cards are unavailable, show the returned view_url so the user can see the catalog photos.

tools.name: compare_offers
tools.description: Compare explicit product offer IDs with a catalog photo per offer when available. Does not assume different pack sizes or products are equivalent. When inline cards are unavailable, show the returned view_url.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search published pet services in Mexico. Location is a text filter, not a verified distance or live schedule.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get source policies, coverage and API discovery links.

tools.name: ask_petia
tools.description: Consult PetiA in any supported model language, grounded in public records. Requires a provisioned bearer token; no customer data.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "ask_petia" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Consult PetiA in any supported model language, grounded in public records. Requires a provisioned bearer token; no customer data.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Mexican product offers, preserving separate seller offers and recorded availability." → after: "Search Mexican product offers with seller, price, recorded availability and catalog photos when available. Pass the original search terms. When inline cards are unavailable, show the returned view_url so the user can see the catalog photos."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
